tasks.question: There are 3 boxes with 4 apples in each box. Two apples are eaten. How many apples remain?
A group has 9 adults. Three leave before buying tickets. Each remaining adult buys 2 tickets. How many tickets are bought?
A shelf has 8 books and receives 4 more. The books are split equally into 3 piles. How many books are in each pile?
